cards.title: Sailors’ Memorial Arch
cards.text: The Soldiers' and Sailors' Memorial Arch is a grand neoclassical monument located in Brooklyn's Grand Army Plaza, dedicated in 1892 to honor those who fought for the Union during the Civil War. It is topped by a massive bronze 'quadriga' featuring Columbia, the personification of America, flanked by two winged figures of Victory. The arch serves as a centerpiece for the borough, often compared to the Arc de Triomphe in Paris for its scale and historical significance.

cards.title: Wonder Wheel
cards.text: The Wonder Wheel is a historic Ferris wheel located in Coney Island, Brooklyn. Built in 1920, it stands 150 feet tall and offers panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean and the New York City skyline. The wheel features 24 cars that can hold up to 6 people each, and it is one of the few Ferris wheels in the world with stationary center support towers.

cards.title: United Nations HQ
cards.text: The United Nations Headquarters is a modern complex located in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. Built in 1952, it is one of the most iconic buildings in the city and a symbol of international diplomacy. The complex features a sleek glass facade and a large plaza in front of it. The building is home to the United Nations General Assembly and Secretariat, as well as various international organizations and conferences.

cards.text: The Vessel is a modern skyscraper located in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. Built in 2018, it is one of the most iconic buildings in the city and a symbol of modern architecture. The complex features a sleek glass facade and a large plaza in front of it.
